statement: The plan sets a goal of meeting 76% of Chinese AI chip demand with domestic chips by 2030, explicitly excluding Nvidia, AMD and Intel silicon because of US export controls.
why: A formal domestic-share target quantifies how much of the China accelerator market Western merchant vendors are expected to lose over the plan period.

impact.mechanism: Policy-driven substitution toward domestic chips removes a share of addressable demand from merchant GPU vendors already restricted by export controls.

evidence.excerpt: 76 percent of Chinese AI chip demand by 2030,

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet reporting a policy target; no primary government text or independent corroboration in the document.
